facts.value: Pricing notes: xAI lists `grok-4.7` at $2.00 input, $0.50 cached input, and $6.00 output per million tokens below 200K prompt tokens. Prompts above 200K use the published $4.00 / $1.00 / $12.00 long-context tier; BenchLM stores the short-context rate.
